blocks.text: **when** («`-ganda`», «`-gan paytda`», «`-gach`») ikki harakatni vaqt bo'yicha bog'laydi: When I got home, I had dinner — Uyga **kelgach**, kechki ovqat qildim. Bunday gap ikki qismdan iborat: **when** li qism (qachon?) va asosiy qism (nima bo'ldi / nima bo'ladi?). Qismlarning tartibi ixtiyoriy: **When I got home**, I had dinner = I had dinner **when I got home**. O'zbek tilida vaqt qismi deyarli doim oldin keladi, inglizchada esa ikkala tartib ham juda tabiiy.

rows: When I came home, she was sleeping. — Uyga **kelganimda** u uxlayotgan edi.
When the lesson finishes, I'll go home. — Dars **tugagach**, uyga ketaman.
When it rains, I stay at home. — Yomg'ir **yog'sa**, uyda o'tiraman.
Call me before you leave. — **Ketishdan oldin** qo'ng'iroq qil.
Don't talk while you're eating. — **Ovqatlanayotganda** gapirma.
Wait until I come. — Men **kelgunimcha** kut.

blocks.text: O'tgan voqealar haqida **when** li qismda ham, asosiy qismda ham o'tgan zamon ishlatiladi: When I **was** a child, I **lived** in Bukhara. Takrorlanadigan, doimiy holatlar haqida esa ikkalasida ham Present Simple: When it **rains**, I **take** the bus. Bu holda **when** «har safar ... `-sa`» ma'nosini beradi. Past Continuous bilan **when** 14-darsda o'tilgan: I was having a shower **when** the phone rang.

items.text: **When** I was at school, I played football every day.
My cat sleeps on my bed **when** it's cold.

blocks.text: Asosiy qoida: kelajak ma'nosida — Present Simple

Kelajak haqida gapirganda asosiy qismda **will** (yoki going to, buyruq) ishlatiladi, lekin **when** li qismda — **Present Simple**: I'll call you when I **get** home. «when I will get home» deyilmaydi. Nega? Asosiy qismdagi **will** kelajakni allaqachon ko'rsatib turibdi, **when** li qism esa faqat vaqtni belgilaydi — ikkinchi marta **will** qo'yish kerak emas. O'zbek tilida ham xuddi shunday: «uyga **borganimda** qo'ng'iroq qilaman» — «borganimda» so'zida kelasi zamon qo'shimchasi yo'q. Demak, kelajak haqidagi gapda «`-ganda`», «`-gach`», «`-sa`» ni ko'rsangiz — inglizchada Present Simple.

rows: When I will get home, I'll call you.
When I **get** home, I'll call you.
I'll wait until you will come.
She'll phone before she will leave.
When you will finish, call me.

items.text: I'll tell Aziz the news **when** he **comes** back.
**When** you **arrive** in Samarkand, send me a message.
We're going to buy a bigger flat **when** we **have** enough money.

blocks.text: Diqqat: savol so'zi **When ...?** («Qachon?») — boshqa narsa. U bilan **will** bemalol ishlatiladi: **When will** you come back? — Qachon qaytasan? Javobdagi vaqt qismida esa yana Present Simple: When I **finish** my exams. Qoida faqat «`-ganda`» ma'nosidagi **when** ga taalluqli.

Bu to'rt bog'lovchi ham **when** kabi ishlaydi: ulardan keyin kelajak ma'nosida ham Present Simple keladi. **before** — «`-dan oldin`», **after** — «`-gandan keyin`», «`-gach`», **while** — «`-ayotganda`», «... paytda» (ikki harakat bir vaqtda), **until** (so'zlashuvda **till**) — «`-guncha`», «... gacha».

rows: I listen to music **while** I cook.

blocks.text: O'zbek tilida «oldin» va «`-guncha`» bilan ko'pincha **inkor** shakl ishlatiladi: «u **kelmasdan oldin**», «sen **kelmaguningcha** ketmayman». Inglizchada **before** va **until** dan keyin fe'l **tasdiq** shaklida qoladi: before he **comes**; I won't leave until you **come**. Inkor faqat asosiy qismda bo'ladi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «When I **will finish** school, I'll go to university.» → When I **finish** school ... ; «Wait until I **won't come**.» → Wait until I **come**. (o'zbekchadagi «kelmaguncha» inkori tarjima qilinmaydi); «Before you **don't leave**, ...» → Before you **leave**, ... ; «After I will eat» → After I **eat**.

Ikki tartib ham to'g'ri, ma'no o'zgarmaydi. Vaqt qismi oldin kelsa — undan keyin vergul: **When the film ends**, we'll go home. Keyin kelsa — vergul kerak emas: We'll go home **when the film ends**. So'zlashuvda ikkinchi tartib juda ko'p uchraydi. O'zbekchada vaqt qismi odatda oldin turgani uchun, ingliz gapini ikkala tartibda ham tuzishni mashq qiling.

items.text: **After** the concert finished, we took a taxi home.
We took a taxi home **after** the concert finished.

blocks.text: Eslab qolish: **when**, **before**, **after**, **while**, **until** — bu so'zlardan keyin **will** qo'yilmaydi. **will** faqat asosiy qismda: I**'ll** call you **when** I **get** home. Xuddi shu qoida **if** uchun ham amal qiladi (99-dars).

Bog'lanish: **will** → 27–28-darslar; **was doing** ... **when** ... **did** → 14-dars; **before** / **after** / **during** / **while** predlog sifatida (before lunch, during the film) → 105-dars; **until** / **since** / **for** → 104-dars.

examples.title: **When** + past: memories and past events
examples.description: O'tgan voqealar: **when** li qismda ham, asosiy qismda ham o'tgan zamon. O'zbekchada — «`-ganda`», «`-ganimda`», «bolaligimda».

sentences.text: **When** I was a child, I lived in a small village near Bukhara.
My father was a taxi driver **when** he was young.
**When** we arrived in Bukhara, it was terribly hot.
sentences.translation: Buxoroga **yetib kelganimizda**, havo dahshatli issiq edi.

sentences.text: Emma cried **when** she heard the news.
Where were you living **when** you met your wife?
**When** the film finished, everybody stood up and clapped.
sentences.translation: Film **tugagach**, hamma o'rnidan turib qarsak chaldi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza was washing her hair **when** the doorbell rang.
sentences.translation: Eshik qo'ng'irog'i **chalinganda** Dilnoza sochini yuvayotgan edi.

sentences.text: Aziz was only nineteen **when** he started his own business.
sentences.translation: Aziz o'z biznesini **boshlaganida** atigi o'n to'qqiz yoshda edi.

sentences.text: Did you speak English **when** you moved to London?
It was snowing **when** we left the house this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab uydan **chiqqanimizda** qor yog'ayotgan edi.

examples.title: **When** + present: things that always happen
examples.description: Odat va doimiy holatlar: ikkala qismda ham Present Simple. Bu yerda **when** — «har safar ... `-sa`», «... bo'lganda».

sentences.text: **When** it rains, I take the bus to work.
My dog always barks **when** someone knocks on the door.
Water turns into ice **when** the temperature falls below zero.
sentences.translation: Harorat noldan pastga **tushganda** suv muzga aylanadi.

sentences.text: I always drink green tea **when** I have a cold.
**When** Madina is nervous, she talks very fast.
What do you usually do **when** you can't sleep?
Our teacher gets angry **when** we're late for class.
**When** I'm in Samarkand, I always visit my uncle.
Children often feel bored **when** there's nothing to do.
In Uzbekistan people usually offer you tea **when** you visit their home.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda biror xonadonga **borsangiz**, odatda sizga choy taklif qilishadi.

examples.title: Future: I'll call you **when** I **get** home
examples.description: Asosiy qoida: kelajak haqida gapirganda **when** dan keyin Present Simple (will emas!), **will** — faqat asosiy qismda.

sentences.text: I'll call you **when** I **get** home.
**When** the rain **stops**, we'll go for a walk.
Sarah will be very happy **when** she **sees** your present.
What are you going to do **when** you **finish** school?
**When** Bekzod **comes** back from Manchester, he'll start a new job.
Can you buy some bread **when** you **go** to the shop?
I'll tell him the truth **when** I **see** him tomorrow.
**When** you**'re** ready, just let me know.
The children will be asleep **when** we **get** back.
My sister wants to be a doctor **when** she **grows** up.

examples.title: Questions: What will you do **when** ...?
examples.description: Savol-javob: kelajak haqidagi savolda **will** asosiy qismda, **when** li qismda esa baribir Present Simple. Savol so'zi **When will ...?** («Qachon?») bilan solishtiring.

sentences.text: What will you do **when** you **finish** university? — I'll look for a job in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Universitetni **bitirgach**, nima qilasan? — Toshkentdan ish qidiraman.

sentences.text: Where will you live **when** you **move** to Oxford? — With my aunt.
Will you call me **when** you **get** to the airport? — Yes, of course.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga **yetib borganingda** qo'ng'iroq qilasanmi? — Ha, albatta.

sentences.text: **When will** you be home? — **When** I **finish** work, at about seven.
Who will look after the cat **when** you**'re** on holiday? — My neighbour will.
sentences.translation: Sen ta'tilda **bo'lganingda**, mushukka kim qaraydi? — Qo'shnim qaraydi.

sentences.text: What will Aziz do **when** he **retires**? — He'll grow vegetables in his garden.
sentences.translation: Aziz nafaqaga **chiqqach**, nima qiladi? — Bog'ida sabzavot yetishtiradi.

sentences.text: Are you going to buy a car **when** you **start** your new job? — No, not yet.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishni **boshlaganingda** mashina olmoqchimisan? — Yo'q, hozircha emas.

sentences.text: How will we find the hotel **when** we **arrive** in Bukhara? — I've got a map on my phone.
sentences.translation: Buxoroga **yetib borganimizda** mehmonxonani qanday topamiz? — Telefonimda xarita bor.

sentences.text: **When will** Dilnoza know her results? — **When** the school **sends** them in July.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza natijalarini **qachon** biladi? — Maktab ularni iyulda **yuborganda**.

sentences.text: Will you be at home **when** I **come** round tonight? — Yes, I'll be in after six.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **kelganimda** uyda bo'lasanmi? — Ha, oltidan keyin uyda bo'laman.

examples.title: **before** and **after**
examples.description: **before** — «`-dan oldin`», **after** — «`-gandan keyin`», «`-gach`». Kelajak haqida ham ulardan keyin Present Simple. O'zbekchadagi «kelmasdan oldin» inkori tarjima qilinmaydi.

sentences.text: Wash your hands **before** you **eat**.
**After** we had lunch, we went to the museum.
I always read a little **before** I go to sleep.
**Before** Emma moved to Tashkent, she didn't know any Uzbek.
sentences.translation: Emma Toshkentga **ko'chib kelishidan oldin** o'zbekcha bir so'z ham bilmasdi.

sentences.text: We'll have dinner **after** your dad **gets** home.
sentences.translation: Dadang uyga **kelgandan keyin** kechki ovqatni yeymiz.

sentences.text: **After** I **finish** this report, I'll make some tea.
Did you lock the door **before** you left?
Don't open your presents **before** the guests **arrive**.
**Before** you **buy** a new phone, read some reviews online.
sentences.translation: Yangi telefon **olishdan oldin** internetdagi sharhlarni o'qib chiqing.

sentences.text: My grandfather felt much better **after** he stopped smoking.
sentences.translation: Bobom chekishni **tashlagandan keyin** o'zini ancha yaxshi his qildi.

examples.title: **while** and **until**
examples.description: **while** — «`-ayotganda`», «... paytda» (bir vaqtdagi ikki harakat); **until** — «`-guncha`». O'zbekcha «`-maguncha`» inkor shaklida, inglizcha **until** dan keyin esa tasdiq.

sentences.text: Someone stole my bag **while** I was sleeping on the train.
sentences.translation: Poyezdda **uxlab yotganimda** kimdir sumkamni o'g'irlab ketdi.

sentences.text: Please wait here **until** I **come** back.
sentences.translation: Men **qaytib kelgunimcha** shu yerda kutib turing.

sentences.text: I'll look after the baby **while** you**'re** at the shop.
sentences.translation: Sen do'konda **bo'lganingda**, chaqaloqqa men qarab turaman.

sentences.text: We stayed in the café **until** the rain stopped.
Don't use your phone **while** you're driving.
Bekzod won't leave the office **until** he **finishes** the report.
**While** Madina was cooking, her husband laid the table.
You can't watch TV **until** you've done your homework.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifangni **qilib bo'lmaguningcha** televizor ko'ra olmaysan.

sentences.text: I didn't know about the problem **until** Sarah told me.
Can you hold my coffee **while** I **find** my keys?

examples.title: Dialogue: a phone call before a trip
examples.description: Ona va o'g'il safar oldidan gaplashmoqda: **when**, **before**, **after**, **while**, **until** dan keyin kelajak ma'nosida Present Simple.

sentences.text: — Call me **when** you **land** in London, OK?
— Of course, Mum, but it'll be very late **when** I **arrive**.
sentences.translation: — Albatta, oyi, lekin **yetib borganimda** juda kech bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — It doesn't matter. I won't sleep **until** you **call**.
— OK. **After** I **leave** the airport, I'll take a taxi to the hotel.
— And what will you do **when** you **get** to the hotel?
— I'll have a shower **before** I **go** to bed, and that's all.
— Don't forget to eat something. You'll be hungry **when** you **wake** up.
sentences.translation: — Biror narsa yeyishni unutma. **Uyg'onganingda** qorning och bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — I'll have a sandwich **while** I'm **waiting** for my bags.
— Good. And send me a photo **when** you **see** Big Ben!
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Big Benni **ko'rganingda** menga surat yubor!

sentences.text: — I will, but not **until** I've **had** a good rest!

examples.title: Mixed: past or future?
examples.description: Mustahkamlash: bir xil bog'lovchi o'tgan va kelasi zamonda. O'tgan voqeada — Past Simple; kelajakda vaqt qismida Present Simple, asosiy qismda **will**.

sentences.text: **When** I saw Dilnoza yesterday, she looked very tired.
sentences.translation: Kecha Dilnozani **ko'rganimda**, u juda charchagan ko'rinardi.

sentences.text: Give Dilnoza this book **when** you **see** her tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Ertaga Dilnozani **ko'rganingda**, unga shu kitobni ber.

sentences.text: We waited at the bus stop **until** the last bus came.
We'll wait with you **until** your bus **comes**.
**While** you**'re** in Oxford, don't miss the Botanic Garden.
**After** the guests left, we washed all the dishes.
**After** the guests **leave**, we'll wash the dishes together.
My brother learned to drive **before** he went to university.
sentences.translation: Akam universitetga **kirishidan oldin** mashina haydashni o'rgangan.

sentences.text: Sarah is going to learn some Uzbek **before** she **travels** to Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Sara Samarqandga **borishidan oldin** biroz o'zbekcha o'rganmoqchi.

sentences.text: Nobody said a word **until** the teacher left the room.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi xonadan **chiqib ketmaguncha** hech kim churq etmadi.
